changelog:
• Live Streams & Sports Feeds Restoration: Purged dead legacy server pools and restored verified 1080p/720p 60FPS sports feeds (DraftKings, CBS Sports Golazo, NBC Sports, ACC Digital, FTF Sports, FITE Combat, beIN Sports, SEC Network, Big Ten Network, NBA TV, MLB Strike Zone, Tennis Channel, YES Network, MSG Network).
• Web PWA Media Pipeline Overhaul: Fixed HLS.js error recovery loop to enable instant sub-second failover across mirrors on Web, and prioritized CORS-enabled HTTPS streams to prevent mixed-content blocks.
• Snappy Mirror Failover: Lowered live stream init timeout to 8 seconds for fast, responsive recovery without freezing on dead feeds.
